title: Correction record (Contract F, v2)
description: Corrections never overwrite model output. A correction is a new row referencing what it changes. Reads apply corrections on top of raw records; deleting a correction undoes it.

scope.description: 'event' means target_id is an event_id. 'track' means target_id is a track_id and job_id is required to disambiguate it.

allOf.$comment: track_id is job-local, so a track-scoped correction is meaningless without its job.
